Report a running tool's progress in the chat

Source: R/progress.R
codeagent_progress.Rd

Call it at the start of a host tool (synchronously, before the tool returns its promise) and keep the handle: update() changes the step shown, done() removes the line. The line is shown above the chat input of the session that runs the tool, with the seconds elapsed counted in the browser.

Usage

codeagent_progress(
  label,
  step = "",
  typical = NULL,
  delay = 3,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

Arguments

label

Character(1). What is running, e.g. "t_ae_socpt_grd".

step

Character(1). The first step shown (optional).

typical

Numeric(1) or NULL. Seconds it usually takes; shown as "usually ~N s" when given.

delay

Seconds before the line appears (default 3).

session

The Shiny session; defaults to the current one.

Value

A codeagent_progress handle: a list with update(step, typical = NULL) and done(). Without a session both do nothing.

See also

codeagent_server()
